verdict.rationale: The pack documents no bulk data export, open-format download, or account-exit/offboarding process for Signifyd. The REST API can retrieve data and the Get Decision API returns decisions one order at a time, but these are developer building blocks for constructing an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
